name: arc_equal(text, text)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION arc_equal(text, text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
 SELECT arc_lower($1)=arc_lower($2)
$function$

name: arc_like(text, text)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION arc_like(text, text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
 SELECT arc_lower($1) LIKE arc_lower($2) ESCAPE ''
$function$

name: arc_lower(text)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION arc_lower(text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
 SELECT translate($1,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
$function$

name: arc_not_like(text, text)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION arc_not_like(text, text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
 SELECT NOT arc_like($1,$2)
$function$

name: instr(text, text)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION instr(text, text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
 SELECT strpos($1,$2)::bigint
$function$
